request.style: English, epic orchestral, male tenor lead with choir, full strings, brass, timpani, harp glissandi, rising from hush to triumph, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Gilgal down to Bethel, from Bethel down to the river
The old prophet and his servant walked the road together
Stay here, the old man told him, but Elisha would not stay
As the LORD lives, I will not leave you, I will walk with you today

[Verse]
At the Jordan Elijah rolled his cloak and struck the water
It parted left and right, they crossed on the dry ground
Ask what I may do for you before I am taken from you
Let me receive a double portion of your spirit

[Chorus]
Suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared
And Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind
My father, my father
The chariots and horsemen of Israel

[Bridge]
And he saw him no more
He picked up the cloak that had fallen
He struck the river as the old man had
And the water parted for him

[Chorus]
Suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared
And Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind
My father, my father
The chariots and horsemen of Israel
